obligations.text: The ready deadline is measured from an observation that the producer's own code is running, never from spawn; the time before that observation is bounded by a separate start deadline.
A sidecar that never starts, starts but never reports ready, or exits first is still refused before the child spawns, under a closing reason that names which deadline ran out.

The start observation reads only what the supervisor already holds or the operating system reports about the process; it adds no protocol message, trusts no producer claim about time, and widens no confinement.

sectionHeadings: 043: The witness sidecar's ready deadline starts when its process starts
record.summary: Amends 013 so the supervisor's ready deadline measures the producer's own startup, not the operating system's assessment of a newly placed executable. A bounded start deadline covers the time from spawn until the producer's code is observed running; the existing ready deadline runs from that observation. Closes the residual 013 records for a ready-timeout under syspolicyd load, and measures the same route on Linux.
record.title: The witness sidecar's ready deadline starts when its process starts
